jobs.title: GIS Developer
jobs.description:
Synergy Business Innovation & Solutions is a premier implementer of cutting-edge software solutions. Synergy brings the experience and expertise necessary to deliver capability that provides tangible ROI to our customers. Our core areas of expertise are in the fields of Digital Transformation, Cloud Solutions, SaaS and Low-Code/No-Code Solutions, Emerging Technologies, Data Analytics and Visualization, Information Assurance, and Business Process Re-Engineering.

Synergy offers its employees a generous portfolio of core and voluntary benefits including: group medical, dental, and vision insurance, company paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance, HSA, FSA, 401(k) with company match, PTO & Bonus Leave, 11 paid federal holidays, parental leave, tuition and training reimbursement, a referral bonus program, and well-being programs.

At Synergy, you’ll be challenged and given the opportunity to grow in your career path. In fact, growth is such a big deal to us that we have career mentors available for every employee, company-funded certification opportunities, education reimbursement, and a general open-door policy so that you have support when you need it. Our team is eager to learn, fast-paced, and quality-driven. If that sounds like you, Synergy has a position for you!

This position has been designated as work-from-home. This is a 30-hours a week position.

**Essential Functions & Duties:**

* Strong knowledge of ESRI product ecosystem, specifically Web Experience Builder.
* Understanding of GIS databases and database architectures.
* Understanding of GIS web and web map services.
* Designs, implements and maintains GIS solutions.
* Experience with ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python.
* Designs, develops, enhances, debugs, implements and troubleshoots geospatial tools and hosted services.
* Researches, tests, builds, and coordinates the conversion and/or integration of new products based on client requirements.
* Addresses problems of systems integration, compatibility, and multiple platforms.
* Consults with project teams and end users to identify application requirements.
* Performs feasibility analysis on potential future projects to management.
* Assists in the evaluation and recommendation of application software packages, application integration and testing tools.
* Resolves problems with software and responds to suggestions for improvements and enhancements.
* Participates in development of software user manuals and technical reports.
* Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) support.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Thorough knowledge of ArcGIS Pro.
* GIS development experience.
* ArcGIS Online/Portal/Enterprise experience.

**Skills, Qualifications and Certifications of Best Candidates:**

* Python.
* JavaScript.
* Github workflow.
* Experience working within Agile.

**Citizenship or Work Authorization Required:**

* Ability to attain Federal Government Position of Trust.
* US Citizen
* Must pass a background investigation.

**Target Salary Range**

Compensation for roles at Synergy is determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the requirements of the role; level of experience; education and certifications; the individual’s combination of knowledge, skills, and abilities; as well as alignment with market data, federal and state laws, and other business and contract considerations. The estimated pay range for this position is: $59,941.00 – $85,630.00. The disclosed range has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case and represent just one component of Synergy’s total compensation package for employees.

**Candidate AI Policy**

Synergy is committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate evaluation process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited **unless permission is explicitly granted.** You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

***Synergy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants for employment or its employees on the basis of age, race (including hair texture/style), creed, color, religion, religious creed, ancestry, national origin, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, sex, medical condition, pregnancy (childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), physical or mental disability, personal appearance, organ donation and hair length associated with race, genetic information or characteristics, family responsibilities, familial status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sexual offense, or stalking, political affiliation, arrest records and criminal convictions, credit information, matriculation, homeless status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including job selection, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination.***

jobs.title: Digital Technology Consultant (Environmental Engineering) - East Business Unit
jobs.description:
Brown and Caldwell (BC), a leading environmental engineering firm, is currently seeking a Digital Technology Consultant to serve as a task lead supporting our Digital Solutions team

The Digital Technology Consulting role is responsible for developing digital technology strategies, evaluating and implementing technology solutions, and helping *water* and *wastewater* clients advance their digital objectives. This includes supporting initiatives related to data management, business intelligence and dashboarding, enterprise reporting, AI enabled solutions, system integration, and digital transformation efforts. This role will lead tasks assessing the state of clients’ data environments, digital systems, reporting capabilities, and related business processes to identify opportunities for improvements and future-state requirements

This role works closely with clients to develop technology roadmaps, evaluate and select solutions, establish supporting business processes, and guide implementation efforts through deployment and adoption. Responsibilities include leading the development of advanced BI reports and dashboards, recommending optimizations for enterprise applications, and collaborating with technical staff in the design and implementation of data integration and analytics solutions. This role will apply recognized data management and governance practices, including DAMA-DMBOK principles, to assess data capabilities, define governance approaches, improve data quality and accessibility, and develop practical roadmaps that maximize the business value of client data assets

Work is performed independently with limited supervision and occasional guidance for complex or strategic issues. The role will also support and lead engagement with Clients to develop concepts into projects, support prepositioning meetings with clients ahead of RFP release, development of RFP responses and support creating scopes of work and fee estimates

The selected candidate may be located in either Eastern or Central time zones, although our ideal candidate would be near one of our offices such as Alexandria, VA, Philadelphia, PA, New York City, NY, or Atlanta, GA.

**Responsibilities**

* Communicate the technology planning approach and frameworks to clients.
* Lead the execution of services for enterprise technology planning, selection/evaluation/implementation of information systems to support client’s business processes and integrating technologies to help clients make the best use of their data, systems, and tools.
* Lead teams to identify, design and implement innovative digital solutions helping clients align technology initiatives with business goals.
* Responsible for all aspects of small to mid-size projects with low degree of technical complexity, involving a small project staff
* Ensure data governance of digital solutions created are in compliance with BC technical standards and cybersecurity policies.
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of data management initiatives, dashboarding, AI embedded tools, reporting and general digital transformation efforts.
* Provide strategic insights through data analysis.
* Facilitate client discussions and make presentations on the status and future initiatives regarding digital technology plans and usage.
* Differentiate between client needs for basic data integration tasks and the development of more complex data engineering pipelines and lead digital solutions technical staff in implementing the identified solutions.
* Provide training and support to less experienced colleagues for their development and understanding of digital technology consulting.
* Support business development activities and lead development of scopes, schedules, and budgets.
* Flexibility to adapt and execute various additional assignments, including PM-related duties, based on evolving needs.

  

**Mentorship**

* May provide mentorship, guidance, support, and knowledge-sharing to help less experienced team members develop their skills and grow within their roles.

  

**Skills and Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of enterprise applications used in the *water*/*wastewater* engineering sector (CMMS, GIS, SCADA, LIMS and Data Technologies) and designing digital solutions to use their data for analysis and business intelligence visualization.
* Expertise in data management and data governance frameworks and policies.
* Strong ability in identifying and designing digital solutions that integrate business IT system data with time-series datasets from sensors and SCADA networks.
* Excellent data analysis, BI tool proficiency, enterprise reporting, and technical problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in facilitating client discussions and presenting work outcomes effectively.
* Demonstrated expertise in creating and implementing processes and plans making effective use of data and digital technology.
* Capacity to support other team members in technology consulting skills development.
* Keeps up to date with digital technology and data management practices, principles, and developments in the *water*/*wastewater* industry.

  

**Experience**

* Typically, a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience is required.
* Experience working with data from *water*/*wastewater*-related enterprise applications (e.g., CMMS, GIS, LIMS, SCADA, PMIS, Asset Management etc.)
* Typically will become certified in BC's Subject Matter Specialist (SMS) Framework and progress through the SMS competencies.

  

**Preferred Experience**

  

* 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong subject matter expertise in a core application *water*/*wastewater* application (SCADA, CMMS, GIS, LIMS, AMI etc.).
* Experience supporting and leading sales activities.
* Experience in leading digital tasks and projects with an emphasis on a client-facing role.
* Experience applying DAMA-DMBOK or comparable data management frameworks.
* Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, data architecture, integration,
